request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, cello, soft piano, light percussion, hopeful and reverent, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Paul writes to saints in Ephesus
Grace and peace from God our Father
Chosen before the world began
To be holy in His love

[Chorus]
Blessed with every spiritual blessing
In the heavenly places we are
Blessed in Christ forever

[Verse]
He chose us in Him before time
Destined for adoption as sons
According to the good pleasure
Of His own perfect will

[Chorus]
Blessed with every spiritual blessing
In the heavenly places we are
Blessed in Christ forever

[Bridge]
To the praise of His glorious grace
Lavished on us in the Beloved

[Outro]
Blessed be the God and Father
Blessed in Christ forever
